description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Terrion Arnold agreed to sign with the Seattle Seahawks on Thursday.
items.impact: Arnold has found a home after a long offseason, and the next step will be whether or not he faces discipline from the NFL after he was connected to a robbery and kidnapping in February. The 23-year-old has spent the last two seasons with Detroit and played in just eight games last season with a shoulder injury. However, he seems to be healthy and ready to go for the upcoming year.
items.title: Terrion Arnold to sign with Seahawks

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Tucker Kraft is on track to suit up for the Packers in Week 1 this season.
items.impact: This has been the hope for Kraft throughout the offseason after suffering a torn ACL last season, and it remains a real possibility. The 25-year-old projects to be a top-five tight end in fantasy this season, and his being available from the start is a huge boost for fantasy owners.
items.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) on track to return Week 1

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Za'Darius Smith worked out with the Cleveland Browns on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith retired after five games with the Eagles last season, but he recently unretired and is eyeing a potential return to Cleveland, where he played in 2023 and 2024. The 33-year-old is a three-time Pro Bowler and is one season removed from a nine-sack season with the Browns and Lions in 2024.
items.title: Za'Darius Smith works out with Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Malik Nabers joined team drills during practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Nabers continues to trend towards being good to go for the season opener. He was in a red, non-contact jersey as he took part in a walkthrough period.
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) takes part in team drills Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots placed RB Terrell Jennings on injured reserve.
items.impact: Jennings is out for the season. New England signed JaMycal Hasty as the corresponding move.
items.title: Terrell Jennings placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots signed RB JaMycal Hasty.
items.impact: Hasty will compete for a depth role in the Patriots backfield.
items.title: JaMycal Hasty signs with Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said he expects Puka Nacua to be back at practice next week.
items.impact: McVay said Nacua left practice on Tuesday with soreness in his psoas. He worked out off to the side during practice on Thursday.
items.title: Puka Nacua (back) expected to be back at practice next week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saints coach Kellen Moore said QB Spencer Rattler will start Saturday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Rattler is currently expected to backup Tyler Shough heading into this season. He should see plenty of reps throughout the preseason.
items.title: Spencer Rattler to start preseason opener Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saints WR Jordyn Tyson left practice early with trainer Thursday with a minor hamstring injury.
items.impact: Triplett notes that Tyson "ended his practice early after a strong start." This will be a situation to monitor for the rookie.
items.title: Jordyn Tyson exits practice Thursday with minor hamstring injury

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.desc: Justin Fields will play in Saturday's preseason opener, per HC Andy Reid.
items.impact: Fields is set to split snaps with Garrett Nussmeier and Chris Oladokun. The Chiefs QB will have an opportunity to showcase what he can do in a Kansas City uniform.
items.title: Justin Fields will play in Chiefs' preseason opener

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes will not play in Saturday's preseason opener, per HC Andy Reid.
items.impact: Mahomes has operated at full capacity throughout training camp, but Kansas City is seemingly playing it safe as he continues to work his way back to 100%. Mahomes could still play later in the preseason to experience live action before Week 1. In the meantime, Justin Fields is expected to get the nod on Saturday.
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II will not play Saturday

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III is reportedly "primed to be the clear workhorse" in the Chiefs' offense.
items.impact: Walker is currently being selected as a low-end RB1 in fantasy drafts. If the Chiefs rely on him as reported, though, Walker has a strong chance to finish as a top-five RB.
items.title: Kenneth Walker III primed for 'workhorse' role

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.desc: Bills HC Joe Brady said starters will play against the Panthers in the preseason opener.
items.impact: Moore has seemingly had an excellent camp. The WR will now have the opportunity to showcase it against his former team in the preseason alongside Josh Allen and the starters.
items.title: DJ Moore will play in preseason opener

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.desc: James Cook III and all Bills starters are set to play Saturday, per HC Joe Brady.
items.impact: Cook is reportedly expected to have a larger role as a pass catcher in 2026. Saturday's preseason opener against the Panthers could offer a preview of the Bills' plans for their RB1.
items.title: James Cook will play in preseason opener

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.desc: Bills HC Joe Brady said starters will play against the Panthers in the preseason opener.
items.impact: Allen and the starters will have an opportunity to knock off any lingering rust while building momentum for the regular season.
items.title: Josh Allen will play in preseason opener

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard (hamstring) is week-to-week with a hamstring injury per HC Dave Canales. He is expected to play in Week 1.
items.impact: While it sounds like Hubbard should be good to go for the season opener, he could still be limited following a multi-week absence. With that said, it's now wheels up for Jonathon Brooks, who's now going to see his ADP rise yet again.
items.title: Chuba Hubbard (hamstring) week-to-week with hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills released DL Kody Huisman.
items.impact: Huisman will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Kody Huisman released by Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills signed CB Anthony Kendall.
items.impact: Kendall will compete in training camp for a depth role in the Bills corner back room.
items.title: Anthony Kendall signs with Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings waived RB Jordan Mims.
items.impact: Mims signed with Minnesota in late July. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Jordan Mims waived by Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: John Michael Schmitz Jr. did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Schmitz was placed in concussion protocol earlier this week. He'll have to clear all protocols before he can return to practice.
items.title: John Michael Schmitz Jr. (concussion) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: JuJu Smith-Schuster did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith-Schuster is continuing to battle a knee injury. He is competing for a depth role in the Giants wide receiver room.
items.title: JuJu Smith-Schuster (knee) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints signed DT Kahlil Saunders.
items.impact: Saunders previously participated in training camp with the Dolphins. He'll compete for a depth role with New Orleans.
items.title: Kahlil Saunders signs with Saints

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints placed OL Dillon Radunz on injured reserve.
items.impact: Radunz tore his ACL in practice last week. He'll miss the upcoming season.
items.title: Dillon Radunz (knee) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans waived WR Montrell Washington.
items.impact: Washington signed with Houston last week. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Montrell Washington waived by Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed K Chris Freeman.
items.impact: Freeman will see some reps during the preseason.
items.title: Chris Freeman signs with Texans
